hints: Dividing by 100 moves the decimal point 2 places to the left.
Start with 75.0 and move the point 2 places to the left. Write a 0 before the point if there is no whole number.

solution.methodName: Percent to decimal: move the point 2 places left

steps.why: Hundredths use 2 places after the point. A quick way: start with 75.0 and move the point 2 places to the left.

trapNotes.7.5: This moves the point only 1 place. Move it 2 places, because percent is out of 100.
trapNotes.75.0: This does not move the point at all. 75.0 is 75 wholes, but 75% is less than 1 whole.
trapNotes.0.075: This moves the point 3 places. Move it only 2 places.
